title: Stay Simpli / Zimmerbuch
description: An accommodation-management workspace for stays, people, rooms and bed-level planning, with reviewable occupancy optimization.
body:
Stay Simpli, also called Zimmerbuch, replaces spreadsheet-based accommodation planning with a structured workspace for stays, people, groups, rooms, and bed spaces.

## What it does

A monthly planner connects stays to rooms and bed spaces. Staff can manage groups, distinguish internal and external accommodation, and use CSV previews, imports, and exports for people and group records.

## Recent work

October work added occupancy optimization for new bookings and existing room allocations. Plans can be previewed before application, preserve fixed and checked-in placements during normal optimization, and account for accessibility and blocked capacity. The server rejects stale plans before applying a valid plan in a transaction. A separate local demo uses synthetic data with email sending disabled; it does not copy guest records.

The August implementation moved stay listings, planner reads, accommodation resources, reference data, and management writes toward a managed PostgreSQL boundary. The work emphasizes explicit data ownership and bounded write paths rather than maintaining competing copies of the same planning spreadsheet.

## Current boundary

This is an operational application under development, not a public guest-data demo. A multi-user deployment requires its own access, privacy, and backup review.
